subject.title: feat(ios): show OpenClaw logo in notch

question: Should OpenClaw accept a shipped iOS screenshot-branding feature that depends on TopNotch's private UIScreen KVC and currently lacks explicit redistributable licensing, or should the branch change direction before merge?
rationale: This is a release, legal/provenance, and App Store risk decision that automation cannot safely settle from code correctness alone.

options.title: Require license and release approval first
options.body: Do not merge until the dependency has explicit redistributable license/provenance, the iOS license bundle is updated, the current archive path passes, and iOS/release owners accept the private API risk.

options.title: Switch to an App Store-safe branding path
options.body: Replace TopNotch/private KVC with a public-API or release-safe screenshot branding approach if maintainers do not want to own the App Store risk.

options.title: Defer the cosmetic overlay
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the screenshot-only branding benefit is not worth the dependency, license, and review cost.

recommendation.title: Require license and release approval first
recommendation.body: Do not merge until the dependency has explicit redistributable license/provenance, the iOS license bundle is updated, the current archive path passes, and iOS/release owners accept the private API risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS release/App Review history makes this the best available routing candidate for the release-risk decision.
